svg.aria-label: The three parts of the workshop, from left to right. Explore: from situations to decisions, then to useful data. Shape, cut short: formats, then level of detail. Test: mockups, client feedback, hypothesis confirmed. Explore and Test, wider and highlighted, took up most of the session.
